title: Remarks on United States Democracy
claim: Biden said democracy was under attack, there is no place for voter intimidation or political violence, and Americans must choose fair and free elections over intimidation and chaos.
source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential transcript with direct dated remarks and explicit democratic-norm language.
period_fit: Direct 2022 target-period rhetoric and democratic framing.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statement as president.
contrary_evidence: The speech is normative and does not by itself prove institutional reform or long-run change.

title: Remarks on Voting Rights in Atlanta, Georgia

period_fit: Direct 2022 position on contestability and voting rights.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden policy stance and advocacy.
contrary_evidence: The proposal failed in Congress, so the source shows intent and advocacy more than achieved reform.
